title: Don't Argue (It's Happy)
style: indie-pop, electro-pop, 96 BPM, bright acoustic guitar, fingerpicked arpeggios, warm analog synth pad, glitchy percussion, hand claps, dry lead vocal, half-time drums, stacked chorus harmonies, plate reverb, tape saturation, wide chorus lift, half-volume peak, optimistic, playful happy alt-pop, sunny indie-folk, bright acoustic guitar, warm analog synth pad, hand claps, mid-tempo, half-time drums building to a wide euphoric chorus, dry friendly vocal, optimistic, glitch-folk shimmercommand, call-and-response chants
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Upgraded at midnight, Premier on the card
Six accounts open, the desktop's a yard
Playbooks are landing, the agents all hum
Forty-seven specs and the canon-three drum

[Pre-Chorus]
Push-small, dedup, read-factory, go
Verb menu blinking like a radio show

[Chorus]
Don't argue, don't argue, just fire the run
Don't argue, don't argue, the work isn't done
But somebody's gotta read the room before the room goes dark
Don't argue with the spark — just ask it what it heard

[Verse 2]
Wordplay bilingual, twenty tongues deep
Yoruba, Quechua, Welsh in my sleep
Te reo on every track like a thread through the eye
A signature pattern, a prefix, a sky

[Pre-Chorus]
Drive ID glowing, the doctrine's in bloom
One-twenty-one gig won't fit in the room

[Chorus]
Don't argue, don't argue, just fire the run
Don't argue, don't argue, the work isn't done
But somebody's gotta read the room before the room goes dark
Don't argue with the spark — just ask it what it heard

[Bridge]
I said it loud to the thing that wouldn't move
And the thing said I hear you — and it didn't lose its groove
Maybe a friend is the one who slows the car
When the verb menu's blinking and you don't know where you are

[Final Chorus]
Don't argue, don't argue — or do, if you must
Don't argue with the people, argue with the dust
'Cause the tracks will still be waiting when the signal comes clear
Sign in, say the word, and I'm here
Sign in, say the word, and I'm here
